title: The Chariot – Tarot, 1000 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Design inspired by Art Nouveau Digital printing of photographic quality Coin for tarot and numerology enthusiasts A perfect gift for a special person Reflection of strength and determination, the chariot symbolizes fearlessness in moving forward in the face of life’s challenges. The silver coin, depicting a meticulously reproduced tarot card from the 19th century, is not only a unique gift, but also a manifesto of readiness to overcome obstacles. This is a unique gift for a steadfast ally in life’s journey.
